default: {namePrefix}Want to log something you spent, or check your budget?
Good to see you. You can speak an expense, add one manually, or ask what you can afford.
Hi there. I can help with spending, limits, or logging a purchase.
{namePrefix}What should we look at in your budget today?
noTransactions: {namePrefix}You have not logged any transactions yet. Want to add your first expense?
Welcome. Start with a quick expense and I can help you track spending from there.
{namePrefix}Try speaking an expense or adding one manually to get started.
noLimits: {namePrefix}You have not set category limits yet. I can help you set up a simple starting budget.
Hi. Set category limits on the Budget screen and I can guide safe-to-spend decisions.
{namePrefix}A few category limits will unlock affordability checks and daily safe-to-spend.
nearLimit: {namePrefix}Your {category} budget is about {percent} percent used. Want a quick breakdown?
Heads up — {category} is getting close to its limit. I can show where the spend is going.
{namePrefix}{category} is at {percent} percent. Want to review it or log something new?
safeToSpend: {namePrefix}You have about {safeAmount} {currency} safe to spend today. Want to log something or check a category?
Your daily safe-to-spend is around {safeAmount} {currency}. I can help log a purchase or review spending.
{namePrefix}Plenty of room today — roughly {safeAmount} {currency} safe to spend. What should we handle?

appGuidance: I can log expenses, review spending, check affordability, and adjust budget limits.

general: I am focused on your budget, but I can help you log a purchase or review spending.
